scope: Test 01 Q080–082, candidate for a true whole intermediate training unit
talk: Bring up to three labelled plants, but no glass pots. Two eligible plants earn early entry; everyone else enters at eleven. In rain, use the gym door, not the garden gate. Volunteers check labels at the open entrance. After noon, unclaimed plants go to the library's seed club. Plants with a return tag stay at the volunteer table. Give a volunteer your name before leaving to get that tag.
talkZh: 最多可帶三盆貼好標籤的植物，但不收玻璃盆。帶兩盆合格植物才可提早入場，其他人十一點入場。下雨時不要走花園大門，請改走體育館入口。志工會在開放的入口檢查標籤。中午後，沒被領走的植物會送到圖書館的種子交換社。有退還標籤的植物會留在志工桌。請在離開前向志工告知你的名字，才能取得這張標籤。
title: A community plant swap

questions.prompt: A donor brings two labelled plants, one in glass. Without changing pots, when can they enter?
questions.promptZh: 捐贈者帶了兩盆貼好標籤的植物，其中一盆用玻璃盆。不換盆的話，何時可以入場？
questions.formalStem: Number 80. A donor brings two labelled plants, one in glass. Without changing pots, when can they enter?
questions.explanationZh: 兩盆雖然都有標籤，但其中一盆用玻璃盆，不算合格；只有一盆就要等十一點入場。
questions.evidence: No glass pots; two eligible plants for early entry; other visitors enter at eleven.

options.whyZh: 玻璃盆不收，只有另外一盆符合規定，不到提早入場所需的兩盆。

options.text: Enter at eleven with the eligible plant.
options.zh: 十一點帶合格的那盆入場。
options.whyZh: 兩盆雖然都有標籤，但其中一盆用玻璃盆，不算合格；只有一盆就要等十一點入場。

options.text: Wait until noon and leave both plants at the volunteer table.
options.zh: 等到中午，把兩盆都留在志工桌。
options.whyZh: 中午的規定是處理沒被領走的植物，不會讓玻璃盆變成合格。

options.text: Enter early after showing that both plants have labels.
options.zh: 證明兩盆都有標籤後提早入場。
options.whyZh: 有標籤只是其中一項條件，仍不收玻璃盆。

vocabulary.note: 同時符合活動所列條件，而不是只貼了標籤。

questions.prompt: It is raining. Where will a volunteer check a plant's label?
questions.promptZh: 下雨時，志工會在哪裡檢查植物標籤？
questions.formalStem: Number 81. It is raining. Where will a volunteer check a plant's label?
questions.explanationZh: 下雨時開放的是體育館入口；志工在開放的入口檢查標籤。
questions.evidence: In rain use the gym door; volunteers check labels at the open entrance.

options.whyZh: 下雨時改走體育館入口，不用花園大門。
種子交換社接收剩餘植物，不負責現場入場檢查。
志工桌保管貼有退還標籤的植物，入場檢查是在開放的入口。
下雨時開放的是體育館入口；志工在開放的入口檢查標籤。

vocabulary.note: 用來表示以一個選項取代另一個選項。

questions.prompt: How can a donor keep their unclaimed plant from going to the seed club after noon?
questions.promptZh: 捐贈者要怎麼做，才能避免自己的植物沒被領走時在中午後送往種子交換社？
questions.formalStem: Number 82. How can a donor keep their unclaimed plant from going to the seed club after noon?
questions.explanationZh: 告知名字後志工才會加退還標籤；有此標籤的植物會留在志工桌，不會中午就送走。
questions.evidence: Unclaimed after noon normally sent away; return-tag plants stay; a volunteer adds the tag after the donor gives a name before leaving.

options.text: Give their name to a volunteer.
options.whyZh: 告知名字後志工才會加退還標籤；有此標籤的植物會留在志工桌，不會中午就送走。

options.text: Leave their early-entry ticket beside the plant.
options.zh: 把提早入場的票放在植物旁。
options.whyZh: 提早入場票不會替植物加上退還標籤。

options.text: Move the plant to the gym entrance.
options.zh: 把植物移到體育館入口。
options.whyZh: 體育館入口是下雨時的入場動線，不是中午保留未領植物的方式。

options.text: Put the plant with the seed club's unclaimed plants.
options.zh: 把植物和要送去種子交換社的植物放在一起。
options.whyZh: 想取回的植物應留在志工桌；放到要送走的那一批反而無法保留。

vocabulary.note: 在交換結束時仍沒有人拿走或領取的。
表示活動結束後應保留原物供捐贈者取回。
